context_requirements: Functional intestinal epithelium with NHE3-mediated sodium absorption or colonic motility machinery
Luminal (apical) drug exposure, which is not achieved by uniform 10 micromolar application to cultured cell lines
Gut microbiota for microbiota-dependent laxative mechanisms
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is not explained by generic stress or cytotoxicity
Evidence of NHE3 (SLC9A3) pathway engagement or epithelial apoptosis signature in the cell lines

evidence.supports: Laxative effect of NHE3 inhibition is mediated by intestinal sodium/water absorption, a tissue-level mechanism absent in cultured cell lines
Laxative effect of pterostilbene in slow transit constipation involves gut microbiota and interstitial cells of Cajal, not a direct transcriptional program in the tested lines
Colonic epithelial apoptosis in melanosis coli is not consistently associated with laxative use, arguing against a specific transcriptional response
